Define movement bounds
---


Create run length column counting consecutive rows wherein velocity >= 20 mm/s

Movement start defined as the first of four consecutive rows threshold is met and acceleration >= 20 mm/s.

```{r}
load(file = here::here("data/proc/03_after_smooth.rdata"))

#     .SDcols = paste0("delta_", hand_cols),
#     by = trajectory
#   ] |>
#   # No longer needed
#   _[, c(paste0("delta_", hand_cols)) := NULL]
#
# # Smooth computed velocities
# # Could definitely be optimized
# for (traj in unique(dt$trajectory)) {
#   dt[trajectory == traj][2:.N][, velocity := filtfilt(butt, velocity)]
# }
#
# dt[,
#   acceleration :=
#     (velocity - shift(velocity, n = 1, type = "lag")) / (1 / 120),
#   by = trajectory
# ]
#
# for (traj in unique(dt$trajectory)) {
#   dt[trajectory == traj][3:.N][, acceleration := filtfilt(butt, acceleration)]
# }
#
# save(dt, file = here::here("data/proc/03_after_smooth.rdata"))

movement_bounds <- dt[,
  .(velocity, acceleration),
  keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num, frame)
] |>
  _[,
    .(
      frame,
      acceleration,
      runs = frollsum(
        velocity >= 20,
        n = 4,
        align = "right",
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),
    keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num)
  ] |>
  _[
    # Instances were thresholds are met
    runs >= 4 & acceleration >= 20,
    # Subset and grab first frame
    .(start_frame = .SD[1, frame]),
    keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num)
  ]

dt <- dt[
  movement_bounds,
  on = .(participant, block_num, trial_num),
  start_frame := i.start_frame
]
```

#### Flag reaches to drop from analyses

Objects were ~30 cm away, along the z-axis. But some noise is expected...

```{r}
dt[, drop := FALSE]

x <- dt[, max(.SD$hand_z), by = .(participant, block_num, trial_num)]

# boxplot(x$V1, horizontal = TRUE, main = "Max hand_z across trials")

# median(x$V1)
# IQR(x$V1)
# mean(x$V1 >= (median(x$V1) - (1.5 * IQR(x$V1)))) # ~ 92% of trials

# mark reaches shorter than the above for removal
dt[,
  # drop := max(hand_z) < (median(x$V1) - 1.5 * IQR(x$V1)),
  drop := max(hand_z) < 300,
  by = trajectory
]

# mark movement end as frame after start where z-pos meets threshold
dt[,
  end_frame := which.max(
    # hand_z >= (median(x$V1) - 1.5 * IQR(x$V1))
    hand_z >= 300
  ),
  by = trajectory
]

dt[
  drop == FALSE,
  drop := ifelse(
    frame < start_frame & frame > end_frame,
    TRUE,
    drop
  )
]
```

Drop any Ss with more than 10% of frames flagged for removal.

```{r}
subjs <- dt[, mean(drop), participant][V1 >= 0.3, participant]
dt <- dt[!participant %in% subjs]
```
